comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Having seen how badly this database was defaced in the past by gold spammers and anonymous flame wars, I much prefer its "refined" state to that of Wikia-style. I do agree that it would be a great idea for the more active and helpful members of the community to have a chance to input and edit quest/item information, though, or be able to delete lingering spam posts like those found over at Common Grass.

I suppose the problems are threefold: some of the data exists, but isn't completely translated or lacking in skill boosts etc. (Tradescant's Outfit, for example), some of it has been translated but lacks details like quest pages, exp values, or skill boosts (numerous discoveries/EQ), and some of the data just doesn't exist in the database, period. Figuring out which is which and how to overcome it, seems a daunting (though not impossible) task.

I think adding the ability to "edit" equipment/ship parts/etc. like you can quest info, or the ability to add new quest page data, like we can already edit existing quest data, would be a good start. Repairing some of the missing database entries (TH clue names seem to have vanished, which is a shame) would also help. I noticed some existing G.T. quest names have been getting updated lately, so there's obviously SOME work going on behind the scenes, however large or small. Maybe a special section where people with admin-granted power could keep a running tally of things 'to-do' and coordinate their efforts. That sort of thing.

We've talked about this a bit in the past over on Composite Bow as well, but for now, I'm afraid there has been no official word on any of our suggestions. Still, life is nothing if not frequently unexpected and busy; I'm sure there's a lot more to running this site than we can imagine. Here's hoping there will be some progress made in the future.

In the mean time, thanks to Curious and other contributors for helping keep the DB as up to date as possible. It's greatly appreciated - not only by me, but many other players, I'm sure. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.

Guide: Sail to Athens and talk to the Barkeep once.

Run over near the Market Keeper and talk to the "Traveller" one time.

To find the discovery, head out to Olympia (past West Athens) and use Recognition near the central area of the map to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: Additional Survey of the Ruins of Pompeii

Obtained in Alexandria Adventure Guild

Prequest: Buried ruins of Rome

Requirements: Recognition r1, Archaeology r2, Greek.

Guide: Sail to Athens and speak with the Adventurer one time.

After that, sail to Naples and talk to the Archaeology Student once as well.

Lastly, travel to Campagna and use Recognition to the left of the center ruins to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: A Collection of Beautiful Stars

Obtained in Naples Adventure Guild

Prequests: "Bull of the Heavens" and "Titan's Range"

Requirements: Recognition r5, Astronomy r7, Italian.

Guide: Sail to Cagliari and speak with the City Official twice.

Then, sail to Pisa and talk to Galileo Galilei 2x.

After that, sail to Tunis and talk to the City Girl by the Archives 2x also.

Talk to the City Youth nearby once.

Finally, sail to the Strait of Gibraltar and use Recognition at night to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: Vanished Temple

Obtained in Seville Adventure Guild

Prequest: Statue of the moon goddess

Requirements: Greek

Sail to Athens and talk to the Traveller one time.

Talk to the Scholar once.

Run back to the Traveller and talk to him one more time. That will end the quest.

Quest: Customs Related to a Holy Place

Obtained in Athens Adventure Guild

Requirements: Recognition r1, Archaeology r3, Arabic

Guide: Talk to the Scholar in Athens once.

Sail to Tunis and talk to the Scholar there one time as well.

Finally, use Recognition near the gate in West Tunis that exits back to Tunis to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: The Truth of the Temple

Obtained in Lisbon Adventure Guild

Prequest: Vanished Temple

Requirements: Recognition r6, Archaeology r8, Greek

Guide: Sail to Athens and talk to the Traveller one time.

Talk to the Scholar once.

Sail from there to Naples and talk to the Scholar once, read a book from the Archaeology shelf once, and then talk to the Scholar one more time.

To complete the quest, sail to Turkey West Coast and use Recognition in the Northern-central area of the map to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: A Strange Stone Monument

Obtained in Naples Adventure Guild

Requirements: Recognition r1, Archaeology r3, Italian

Guide: Sail to Genoa and talk to the City Girl once.

From there, sail to Cagliari and speak with the Maiden one time.

Then go outside of Cagliari and use Recognition to find the discovery.

comments.body:

Obtained in Amsterdam Adventure Guild

Requirements: Ecological research r1, Biology r2, English

Guide: Sail to Dublin and talk to the Medicine Trader Maiden 3x.

After that, sail to Bordeaux and talk to Pare once.

Finally, travel to the outskirts of Nantes and use Ecological research to the east of the gate to find the discovery.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: There's no way currently for us to physically add new quests, sadly. But some helpful users, like Curious, have posted quest walkthrough guides on this page, as a handy point of reference for the time being.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: The Vitality of the Large Family

Obtained in Amsterdam Adventure Guild

Prequest: The Suffering of a Large Family

Requirements: Ecological research r1, Biology r3, English

Guide: Go to Dublin and talk to the Medicine Trader Maiden 3x.

Talk to the Shipwright once.

Then sail to London and talk to the Scholar one time.

After that, go to Oxford and talk to Justine 2x.

Lastly, go and use Ecological research by the North-east Carriage in Oxford to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: The Happiness of the Large Family

Obtained in Amsterdam Adventure Guild

Prequest: The Vitality of the Large Family

Requirements: Ecological research r2, Biology r4, English

Guide: Sail to Dublin and talk to the Medicine Trader Maiden 4x.

Travel to Oxford and talk to Justine 3x.

Travel to the Outskirts of Genoa and click on the Giant Dead Tree.

Finally, head west a little bit and use Ecological research to find the discovery.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Quest: Gods of Greece and Egypt

Obtained in Marseilles Adventure Guild

Preqests: Statue of the greatest Greek god, and Egyptian god of the sky

Requirements: Search r6, Theology r8, Arabic

Guide: Sail to Athens and talk to the Scholar 2x.

From there, sail to Alexandria and talk to the Scholar there 2x as well.

Then go to Cairo and talk to the Rent House Master once.

Lastly, travel to Cairo Opposite Shore and use Search just west of the Oasis to discover the Bust of Serapis

comments.body:
Quest: Sibling Planets

Obtained in London Adventure Guild

Prerequisites: Pollux, and Castor.

Requirements: Recognition r4, Astronomy r6, English.

Guide: Talk to the Barkeep once.

Sail to Edinburgh and talk to the Priest there 3x.

Travel to Dublin and talk to the Priest there one time.

Then travel to South Greenland Sea and use Recognition at night to discover Gemini
